box_rule.text:
One box per ramp: the whole constructed ramp surface — sloped apron + detectable-warning pad + side flares.
Bottom edge: where the ramp meets the gutter or street. Top edge: where the slope levels into the sidewalk.
Exclude road/gutter pavement, level sidewalk, and neighboring ramps.
A corner apron that point review counted as two ramps gets two boxes, one per direction of travel — overlap is fine.
Occluded is not absent: box the inferred full extent behind cars/pedestrians; truly undeterminable -> "Can't determine extent".
Tight beats symmetric: every edge should touch the ramp's boundary at native zoom.
The box is a measuring instrument, not the crop: road and surrounding context are what a crop rule adds AROUND your box and gets scored on — never include them.
Oblique ramps (running toward the horizon): keep the box axis-aligned and touch the ramp's extremities — empty corners are correct, don't rotate-fit by eye.
